title: Bali Quokka Bounce
style: Aussie family pop with Bali street-percussion, clap stacks, bright acoustic guitar, gamelan bells, and a bouncy syncopated groove; verse rotates as playful solo lines, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal clicks, chorus opens with gang harmonies and chant hooks. Six-way stacked family vocals, cheeky ad-libs, short delay throws on names, little shout fills, and a sunlit punchy mix with local-market texture and celebratory crowd energy., happy, comedy, bounce, oi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey happy, smart core,
Dunedin kiwi at the door.
Michelle on the pickleball court,
Mishy Mish Mash, call me for sport.

Ruby, roo roo, brush my hair,
My art stays with me everywhere.
Wez goes gaming, coach in the lane,
Wezza with a grin and a Spanish flame.

[Pre-Chorus]
Dollar dollar dollar, Bali street food belly,
Local flavours everywhere, moving all so jelly.
Ruby, Wesley, can you swim?
B—I got this, da da, watch us grin.

[Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Corey takes the stage tonight
My turn, family, shining bright

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Bali friends sing with me
On this coast, we’re wild and free

[Verse 2]
Corey codes the super mind,
Turning it around, he’s that kind.
Reverse, forward, engineeer
Upside down, then crystal clear.

What’s da pelican reckon, mate?
Rotto quokka at the gate.
Pink and grey galah goes high,
Micha, Wez, and bo bo, aye i i.

[Pre-Chorus]
Platt your hair, let it swing,
Sun and salt on everything.
Two dogs running, lots of frogs,
Local culture in the logs.

[Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Corey takes the stage tonight
My turn, family, shining bright

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Bali friends sing with me
On this coast, we’re wild and free

[Bridge]
Micha, where’s ya now?
Off she goes, super-dog speed somehow.
Asher, Ashley, through the yard,
We all laugh hard, we all go far.

Ruby, roo roo, kanga bounce
Wez goes wezza, count it out
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha
Mishy Mish Mash, ta ta ta

[Final Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Corey takes the stage tonight
My turn, family, shining bright

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Aussie Aussie Aussie, loud and clear
Bali friends sing with me
Local flavours everywhere, family!
